unsupported: Hana Technologies, Inc. was founded in 1999 in Solon, Ohio, as a member of the Hana Microelectronics Group, a family-owned enterprise that traces its roots to 1978 when Hana Microelectronics Public Co., Ltd. was established in Thailand.
Hana serves industries such as electronic components, RFID and IoT, automotive (including tire manufacturers), packaging, smart cards, LED lighting, and silicon carbide power electronics.
Customers include organizations like the Auburn University RFID Lab and global brands deploying Impinj M830-based inlays such as the Brava and TX5015 models.
